homeassistant.name: Home Assistant
homeassistant.description: Connects this workshop to a Home Assistant, so other plugins can reach the devices it already owns.

settings.title: Connection
settings.description: One address and one long-lived token for the whole instance. Other plugins reach Home Assistant through this connection — printing a label on a Niimbot the household already has, for example.

baseUrl.label: Address
baseUrl.help: Where Home Assistant answers on your network. Both the plain address and the one ending in /api are accepted.

token.label: Long-lived access token
token.help: In Home Assistant, open your profile, go to Security and create a long-lived access token at the bottom of the page.

settings.checkOk: Home Assistant {version} answered, and this token can read {count} entities.
settings.checkNoEntities: Home Assistant {version} answered, but this token cannot read any entity.
settings.saveFailed: The connection could not be saved.

errors.notConfigured: Home Assistant is not connected yet.
errors.badUrl: That is not a valid http:// or https:// address.
errors.timeout: Home Assistant did not answer in time.
errors.notFound: Home Assistant has no such endpoint ({status}).
errors.badResponse: The answer did not look like Home Assistant.

settings.write: Save the Home Assistant address and token
settings.test: Check the Home Assistant connection and report its version
settings.baseUrl: Home Assistant base URL, with no trailing path
settings.token: Long-lived access token; omitted keeps the stored one, empty clears it
